2.w: “Even this day my complaint is bitter; my hand is heavy upon my groaning.

3.w: Who will grant [that] I might know and find Him, [and] come unto His seat!

4.w: I would set forth to his face my case, and my mouth I would fill [with] arguments.

5.w: I would know the words He would answer me, and I would understand what He would say to me.

6.w: In the abundance of strength would He contend with me? No, surely He would set [it] upon me.

7.w: There the upright could argue with Him, and I would escape forever from the One judging me.

8.w: Behold, east I go, and He is not there, and west, and I do not perceive Him.

9.w: In the north, in His working, I do not behold [Him]; He turns to the south, and I do not see [Him].

10.w: Yet He knows the way with me; He has tested me, [and] like gold I will come forth.

11.w: My foot has held firm by His steps; His way I have kept, and I have not turned aside.

12.w: And I have not departed from the commandment of His lips; more than my portion I have treasured the words of His mouth.

13.w: And He is of one, and who can turn Him back? And His soul has desired, and He has done.

14.w: For He carries out [what is] appointed for me, and many like these [are] with Him.

15.w: Upon thus, I am terrified before His face; I consider [this], and I am afraid of Him.

16.w: And God has softened my heart, and Shaddai has terrified me.

17.w: For I was not cut off from the face of darkness, and before my face He has covered the dark gloom.
